newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot resid prices little changed again.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot resid prices little changed again.

text.p: U.S. spot fuel oil prices stayed little changed again Friday despite the lack of utility demand, still supported by firmer NYMEX energy prices, industry sources said.
"Nobody wants to break this market yet, especially with crude where it is," said one cash trader.
In New York Harbor, physical one percent remained talked at $21.25 a barrel, with November paper steady to up slightly to $21.50-70 on firmer crude, traders said.
High sulphurs in New York were steady to up slightly, with 2.2 percent talked just over $20.
At the U.S. Gulf, prices mostly were unchanged, but traders said some signs of softer bunkers there may finally halt the recent high sulphur run.
USG one percent was still at $20.00-25, while three percent eased slightly to $20.25 on talk of better avails.
No NYH or USG deals were reported.
New York City gate gas prices were little changed Friday at $2.75-2.80/mmBtu versus NYH one percent resid still at a $3.37/mmBtu equivalent.
